recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. To complete the original resolution across repositories, add a List list-for extension SearchParameter in the FHIR Extension Pack or explicitly record that the work group no longer wants a standard search parameter for this extension.
issue_request: FHIR-26298 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core request to add a List field indicating whom the list is for. The approved resolution chose a standard extension and associated search parameter instead of adding a core List element.
initial_application: Commit 027acecb014e70ac1007bd1a76706c6d60a05b21 added the list-for StructureDefinition under source/list, registered it in the List implementation guide, and updated the current-allergies List example. I found no historical core application of the associated extension search parameter. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed core extension definitions as part of the R5 move to the hl7.fhir.uv.extensions package while leaving the example and OID reference in core.
additional_context: Current core source keeps List active and approved, and source/history.html states that extensions moved to hl7.fhir.uv.extensions while still being published as part of the specification. The Extension Pack contains StructureDefinition-list-for with List context and the expected reference targets, and FHIR-43342 later improved that extension's description there. The Extension Pack input and current build search-parameter registry do not contain a list-for SearchParameter. FHIR-27083 and the 2022 Zulip reopening discussion address the patient-list concern by pointing to Group preference guidance while preserving list-for for valid List use cases.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because the extension definition has intentionally moved out of core and the only apparent unfinished work, if still desired, is an extension SearchParameter in HL7/fhir-extensions.

related_jiras.note: Published List/Group clarification that handles the later concern that list-for could encourage misuse of List for patient dashboards; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Published FHIR-extensions issue that improved the list-for extension description in the Extension Pack, confirming later maintenance moved outside core.
